product.title: Best of Yosemite Small Group Tour: Giant Sequoias & Glacier Point

description.text: See Yosemite's greatest hits on a small-group day tour combining Tuolumne Grove giant sequoias with Glacier Point's sweeping valley panorama. Your guide handles park logistics while you focus on Tunnel View, Yosemite Valley, and alpine viewpoints.

highlights: Walk among giant sequoias at Tuolumne Grove
Glacier Point overlook above Yosemite Valley
Tunnel View and valley floor photo stops
Hotel pickup available from select locations

start.description: Pickup from select hotels in the Yosemite gateway area starting at 7:30 AM.

end.description: Return to your original hotel pickup point.

product.itinerarySummary: See Yosemite's greatest hits on a small-group day tour combining Tuolumne Grove giant sequoias with Glacier Point's sweeping valley panorama.

itineraryItems.title: Tuolumne Grove
itineraryItems.description: Hike the grove trail among mature giant sequoias including a walk-through tunnel tree.

itineraryItems.title: Tunnel View
itineraryItems.description: Classic valley overlook stop with views of Half Dome and Bridalveil Fall.

itineraryItems.title: Yosemite Valley
itineraryItems.description: Drive through the valley with commentary on El Capitan and Cathedral Rocks.

itineraryItems.title: Glacier Point
itineraryItems.description: Stand at the rim overlook for sweeping views of Half Dome and Yosemite Falls.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

faqs.question: How long is the Best of Yosemite Small Group Tour: Giant Sequoias & Glacier Point?
Where does the tour depart from in Yosemite?
faqs.answer: Pickup from select hotels in the Yosemite gateway area starting at 7:30 AM.
